title: Marlin C NDE 3754/5329 NDE 5329
content:
5329 It started out like indigestion, so I took some Rolaids and it went away. I thought that was it. About 15 minutes later it came back, so I took some more. The same thing, it went away. Then it came back, and I took more Rolaids, but this time it didn't go away. The pain came up into the center of my chest and it felt like my chest was going to explode. I started to panic a little because I had never experienced anything like it before. I called 911 and the ambulance came. They were taking a long time to get me ready to transport. They had a beginner on, and he was trying put an IV in my arm and was having no success. On the way to hospital, they were taking their sweet time about it. They were driving normal speed and had the flashing lights on until the attendant called the hospital on the radio and told them my symptoms. The person on the other end said, my God, he's having a massive heart attack - get him here quick! Then they turned on the siren and sped up.

When we got to the hospital I was in the emergency room and the doctor asked me if I had been smoking crack cocaine, I told him no. I had two more trainees trying to put IVs in my arms. As they were working, the doctor asked me again about the coke. Again, I said no. He told me the reason was that, if I had, he was going to give me a new type of blood thinner and, if had smoked crack, I would bleed out and die. Just as they started to put the medicine in, my heart stopped and I died.

The instant I died I was standing in front of the brightest light I have ever seen, but it didn't hurt my eyes to look at it. I was standing in pitch blackness and then this voice came into my head telling me to step into the light, so I thought to myself, 'I don't know about that, I've never experienced anything like this before.' Then the voice said it again so I stepped into the light. It's hard to explain the feeling I had when I first stepped in it. It was like every cell in my body came alive with the most exhilarating feeling of love like you have never felt in all your life. The first thing I felt was an overpowering feeling of love, then came peace, and then came contentment. I was only dead about two or three minutes but it took me about a minute to recuperate from that. Then I started looking around and I saw flowers and trees. Everything around me felt like it was emanating love towards me, and then all of a sudden I was looking at the doctor's face. I was so mad that he had done that that I grabbed his shirt collar and asked him why he did that. He pointed to my wife and mother and said, 'They told me to!' arrival.other_being_detail: A voice in his head told him to step into the light.

environment.environment_other_detail: He described 'pitch blackness' and then stepping into 'the brightest light' and later seeing 'flowers and trees.'

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: He reported hearing a voice telling him to step into the light; later he was suddenly looking at the doctor's face and reacted angrily.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: He described being in pitch blackness, then a voice telling him to step into a bright light; after being in a loving environment with flowers and trees, he suddenly perceived the doctor's face.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: He described grabbing the doctor's shirt collar and confronting him immediately after 'all of a sudden I was looking at the doctor's face.'
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “The instant I died I was standing in front of the brightest light I have ever seen, but it didn't hurt my eyes to look at it.” / “It was like every cell in my body came alive with the most exhilarating feeling of love like you have never felt in all your life.” / “I've been wanting to go back ever since!!!”
